quantifier.c8_outgoing: Every actual persistent ordinary q=1 full-carrier d=1 parent P whose replayed q_star=103 path reaches a c=8 checkpoint H after the complete terminal-first policy misses.
quantifier.atomic_reentry: Every nonterminal atomic output produced by an actual parent-bound H4_A1 or C8_DOUBLE_LOW macro occurrence admitted under the frozen T2v1 arms.

actualness_requirements: A persistent parent state_id admitted through the common F1 gate.
A replayable parent-to-checkpoint or parent-to-H4 path digest.
A terminal-first MISS receipt covering the complete policy prefix.
An actual raw path occurrence; a chart-local source reconstructed from a bare target is insufficient.
A canonical two-sided complete-excess payload when an atomic split is used.

bare c=8 or bare H4 charts lacking an admitted persistent parent and replayable path
conditional arithmetic fixtures not proved reachable from an actual parent
overflow and post-G families owned by other F2 tracks

F4 selector assembly, F5 independent closure audit, global T6 closure and the Erdos-Straus conjecture
frozen_positive_content: The H4_A1 and C8_DOUBLE_LOW arm schemas exist at phase-local T2v1 level.
A parent-bound double-low occurrence has a conditional deterministic canonical target and an identity solution lift.
Atomic target integers admit a target-local hit/F/G trichotomy once their chart is constructed.
The existing controls reject a bare checkpoint and forbid inherited target labels.
open_obligations: Prove that every actual c=8 parent has exactly one of the three required outgoing dispositions.
Construct the OTHER_VERIFIED_SUCCESSOR branch or prove that branch empty or terminal.
Replace pending_suffix and pending_dispatch with one common nonpersistent atomic serializer followed by a final admitted disposition.
Prove parent-to-final E1-E5, including a strict fixed N^7 T5 ticket, for every nonterminal output.
Prove every final F/G output re-enters an approved active family rather than merely carrying an F/G label.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer actualness from recursive_edge_eligible=true or persistent_queue=true.
Do not reconstruct a persistent parent from a bare prime, chart, divisor or chart-local source.
Do not promote the p=73, p=241 or p=157393 controls to universal existence or totality.
Do not infer E3 admission from a target family or F/G/hit label.
Do not infer N^7 E5 from a checkpoint-local or phase-local rank drop.
Do not register pending_suffix, pending_dispatch, AtomicPendingTargetV1 or a conditional adapter as a persistent successor.
Do not treat the logical complement of DOUBLE_LOW as an existing OTHER successor.
Do not modify the shared grammar, producer registry, frontier, runtime or generated index in this track.
closure_rule: This track closes only if every quantified input has a symbolic exhaustive disposition and every nonterminal final target passes actual parent/path replay, deterministic construction, common E3 admission, universal E4, parent-to-final N^7 E5 and selector re-entry. Otherwise publish the least residual predicate and keep F2 open.
